item.title: DIY OCXO
item.description:
Introduction

I came into the office on a 3 day weekend to mess around with some hobby projects today. But then I realized, I could work on the usual, but, crystal oscillators sure are cool, so for no real reason, I decided to make my own OCXO.

Why I love Clocks

As a lover of radio communications and digital logic, timing circuits are one of my favorite bits of technology. There is something spiritual about clocks. The idea, that a device, ticking every second, using modern technology, can tick no more than 1 extra time a year. It has no concept of time relative to other clocks, but can keep it so accurately, that it seems like the whole world is in sync.

item.title: First Post
item.description:
Hello, welcome to my blog!

I am an electrical engineer and embedded systems engineer from Florida. I started this blog because despite my 6-7 years of experience, I don’t have much of a portfolio to look back on. My professional work has always been deep under NDAs and a lot of my personal projects have been undocumented one off learning experiences.

I want to change that, and share both my one off projects, and parts of my more long term personal projects.
